name: ALTERNATING DUMBBELL SHOULDER PRESS
introduce: Hold a dumbbell in each hand. Raise and bend your arms at 90 degree angles to your sides, keep your upper arms parallel to the floor and palms facing forward. \n\nRaise your hands alternately above your head, then slowly lower them. Repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Exhale as you raise your arm, and inhale as you lower it.
